LanguageData.StoneButhersBlock.label: Stone Buthers Block
LanguageData.StoneButhersBlock.description: A heavy table for butchering dead creatures into pieces of raw meat.
LanguageData.StoneResearchBlock.label: Stone research block
LanguageData.StoneResearchBlock.description: A simple stone table with pestel mortar for grinding herbs scones and mixing liquids. Also a tablet for recording observations. Researchers work here to discover new things.
LanguageData.StoneWorkingStation.label: Stone Working Station
LanguageData.StoneWorkingStation.description: A stone table with simple stone tools used for cutting stone chunks into usable blocks and creating stone weapons and tools.
